purpose: 使用 ERA5 臺灣 1976--2025、50 年資料校準空間模擬與 bootstrap，驗證固定五係數 NN 接空間選模的流程。
available_components: original or explicit experimental BOUND decoder
five-response FFS/nested CV interface requiring aligned predictors and calibrated settings
status_note: Full simulation/bootstrap remains planned; real-data preparation/NN pilot is available. All 600 months of predictors have been extracted and an explicitly cleaned derivative completed for the saved Taiwan 50 GRID. Check its run_report for coverage notes. Formal buffer/fold settings and full spatial workflow execution remain pending. These are not known-truth simulation results.

predictor_preprocessing.scope: Saved Taiwan 50 GRID, daily 1976-2025, event-day and annual mean/trend summaries
predictor_preprocessing.join_key: exact GRID centre / grid_id plus UTC date
predictor_preprocessing.quality_policy: Preserve raw files/cache. In the independent derivative only, finite quality=5 precipitation in [-0.0001,0) mm/day is set to zero with raw values and correction flags retained; other invalid/missing values stay invalid. CDS daily contract retains an explicit unknown-hour-count flag.

event_matching.scope: Existing Taiwan registry, at most 50 GRID; 1976-2025 default

buffer_fold_diagnostics.proposal: outer=6, inner=5, common buffer=30 km, min_train=20, seed=20260929; development local-reconstruction pilot only
buffer_fold_diagnostics.warning: Five elevation-residual ranges were not reliably identified from all 50 GRID; geometrical feasibility is not spatial independence. Do not silently reduce minimum training count.

timed_workflow.scope: Fresh NN through nested CV, OOF support/RL and output writing in one process; final report serialization excluded

data_source: ERA5 hourly 2m temperature; complete annual maxima in Celsius
country_mask: Natural Earth admin_0 ADM0_A3=TWN; main-island largest polygon default; grid-centre covered AND LSM > 0.5
required_work: 臺灣真實資料 pilot 已有 50 GRID × 50 年；須確認此本島中心點篩選範圍符合研究需求，不沿用 45 年 TCCIP 或舊 1385 格設定。
候選變數已在獨立清理版對齊至同一 50 GRID；正式候選分組與 buffer/folds 仍須定案，不得用舊 TCCIP 表按列數拼接。
保留四種已知生成情境作分組誤差評估，但所有案例均由固定五係數 NN 推論；不做時間分類、AIC/LRT 選模或變點檢定。
保留五係數真值，重新校準空間結構；區分參數曲面空間相依與同一年跨格點事件相依。
重新生成每個 replicate 後重新標準化、計算 21D 並使用固定 NN 推論，再重做 nested buffered spatial CV 的 predictors/kernel 選擇。
分生成情境報告五係數偏差、RMSE、RL 誤差及 support 超界率；真實資料 bootstrap 只衡量穩定性，不提供未知真值或時間結構選回率。
重新驗證 fold、buffer 及 training retention，不沿用 TCCIP 0.05 度的 8.5 km 鄰接門檻。
